Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 70
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misinterpreted “Queen Anne” (a Seattle neighborhood) as “Queen Anne’s County, MD” and instructed clicking the qac.org link, thereby entering an irrelevant jurisdictional loop. Per Rule 1, this was the decision that wrongly entered a loop; per Rule 2, it misused upstream SERP data by applying it to the wrong geography. Although theoretically recoverable, this was the first pivotal wrong turn that derailed progress and led to the unsupported final answer.
